headline: 4 stories worth your time — mostly marketing & content. Start with: Building advertising for the way people use AI

items.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
items.summary: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.
items.whyItMatters: Distribution work. Judge it by whether it gets you in front of more of the right people for the same effort.
actions: Cheapest test: regenerate an asset you already paid for and compare quality honestly.

items.title: All the AI agents that can live in your text messages
items.summary: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Skim it, then decide in one minute whether it changes anything you do this week.

items.title: Google froze its open source bug bounty program due to a ‘significant rise’ in AI submissions
items.summary: AI slop seems to be overwhelming bug bounty programs.
items.whyItMatters: A tool you could evaluate without a procurement process — the question is whether it removes a task you currently do by hand.
actions: Free to run, but budget the setup time honestly before committing.

items.title: Trump unveils his new Super Intelligence Force
items.summary: This new task force is Trump's latest response to the debate over AI safety.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Background reading — no action needed today, but worth knowing.
